user.title: Choose a live model provider
user.description: Use either Google Gemini Live or OpenAI GPT Realtime with the Home Assistant voice pipeline.

provider.title: Connect to {provider}
provider.description: Enter the provider API key and choose how the live model should respond.

data_description.api_key: Audio, text, Home Assistant tool schemas, and tool results are sent to the selected provider.
data_description.model: Realtime audio model used for voice and typed conversations. After a model change, the form may refresh once to show only settings supported by that model.
data_description.voice: Built-in voice used for spoken replies.
data_description.system_instruction: Optional custom personality and behavior. Home Assistant's Assist tool instructions are appended automatically.
data_description.detailed_logging: Write transcripts, model details, and tool calls to the Home Assistant log. Enable only while troubleshooting.
data_description.transcribe_gemini: Stream Gemini's spoken-response transcript into Home Assistant. Disabling this gives the lowest reply-audio latency.
data_description.transcribe_gpt: Stream GPT's spoken-response transcript into Home Assistant. Disabling this gives the lowest reply-audio latency.
data_description.encourage_web_search: Tell the model to use an exposed search-like Assist tool for current or explicitly requested online information.
data_description.search_grounding: Allow Gemini to use Google's built-in Search tool for current and verifiable web information. Search queries may incur additional Gemini API charges.
data_description.thinking_level: Controls how much background reasoning Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking uses. Higher levels can improve complex answers but may increase latency and cost.
data_description.show_text: Expose show_text so the model can display formatted text when response transcription is off.
data_description.support_barge_in: Experimental: keep microphone audio streaming while the live model is speaking so the user can interrupt a response. Requires a full-duplex voice client/satellite that keeps transmitting microphone audio during playback, and may increase realtime audio usage.
data_description.affective_dialog: Let the model pick up on the tone and emotion in your voice and adapt its own speaking style to match, so replies sound more empathetic and natural. Only available on Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio Preview (12-2025).

spending_cap_exceeded.title: Gemini Live billing unavailable
spending_cap_exceeded.description: The Google AI project used by **{entry_title}** cannot process Gemini Live requests because its spending cap or available prepaid credit balance has been exhausted. [Manage the project's billing]({spending_cap_url}), then try Gemini Live again. This issue will clear automatically after Gemini Live connects successfully.

openai_no_credits.title: OpenAI credits depleted
openai_no_credits.description: The OpenAI account used by **{entry_title}** cannot process GPT Realtime requests because it has no credits remaining. [Add credits to the account]({billing_url}), then try GPT Realtime again. This issue will clear automatically after GPT Realtime connects successfully.
